items.body_excerpt:
Back home in Wisconsin, Tyrese Haliburton is wearing his Hali 1 Oshkosh North PE shoes, which he gifted to the boys and girls basketball teams at his HS.

He was inducted into the school's HOF earlier this year; he made a $3M donation last year.
